stock.description: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a property management service provider in China. The company offers property management services for residential communities under the Oriental Courtesy, Elegant Life, and Harmony Courtyard brands; trinity services, including property management, asset management, and corporate services for commercial and office buildings under the Nebula Ecology brand; and public services under the Poly Public Services brand. It also provides value-added services to non-property owners and property developers, such as pre-delivery services to assist with sales and marketing activities at property sales venues and display units, which include visitor reception, cleaning, security inspection, and maintenance, as well as consultancy, inspection, delivery, and engineering maintenance services; and office leasing services. In addition, the company offers community value-added services to property owners, including home furnishing, parking space agency, house rental and sales agency, housekeeping, parking lot, and other services, as well as community retail and space operations. Further, it provides consulting, landscaping, catering management, and environmental services. Additionally, the company engages in the research and development of intelligent technology products, automatic systems, and electronic products. The company was formerly known as Poly Property Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. in July 2020. Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Guangzhou, China. Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd.

moat.method: AI qualitative assessment anchored to dated financial statements and available transcript; not a reported accounting measure

provenance.ebitda: Analyst ebitdaAvg when supplied; otherwise analyst EBIT plus modeled D&A, explicitly derived. YTD operating EBITDA is reported operating EBIT plus cash-flow D&A, not an adjusted analyst measure.
provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.
provenance.riskFreeRate: User-directed USD Treasury proxy under the HKD/USD peg; not an observed HKD yield or a copied US-stock WACC
provenance.tax: TTM effective tax; scenario assumption, not a marginal-rate forecast
provenance.kd: TTM accounting interest / average reported debt; not a current financing quote
provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response
provenance.terminalG: 2.25% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable
provenance.investments: Long-term investments assumed nonoperating at book value; adjustable, not fair-value evidence
provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
provenance.leases: Cash-flow-matched debt reconciliation: liabilities whose payments remain in FCFF are not deducted again; financing treatment requires matching profit, depreciation and reinvestment adjustments
